name: monarch-money-mcp
description: Accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, merchants, rules, and more from Monarch Money.
long_description:
An unofficial MCP server for Monarch Money. It reads and edits your accounts, transactions, categories, budgets, recurring bills, savings goals, merchants, and rules.

Sign-in: every setting is optional. If you leave them all blank, the extension uses the session token saved by running `monarch-money-mcp login` once in a terminal (see the README). If you fill in your email and password (and MFA secret, if your account uses 2FA), the extension logs in by itself and logs in again when the token expires. Those values are stored in your system keychain. If Monarch asks for a CAPTCHA, run `monarch-money-mcp login --cookies` instead, or paste your browser's Cookie header into the Browser cookies setting.

monarch_email.title: Monarch email
monarch_email.description: Optional. With your password, lets the extension log in by itself. Leave blank to use the token saved by `monarch-money-mcp login`.

monarch_password.title: Monarch password
monarch_password.description: Optional. Needed with your email for automatic login. Stored in your system keychain. Leave blank to use the saved login token.

monarch_mfa_secret.title: MFA secret
monarch_mfa_secret.description: Optional. The 2FA setup key (from "Can't scan?" when turning on 2FA), not a 6-digit code. Only needed for automatic login on accounts with 2FA. Treat it like a password.

monarch_cookies.title: Browser cookies
monarch_cookies.description: Optional. For when Monarch blocks password login with a CAPTCHA. The Cookie request header from a signed-in app.monarch.com tab (it must include session_id and csrftoken). Stored in your system keychain. Replace it when it stops working.

session_file.title: Session file
session_file.description: Optional. Where the login token is saved. Leave blank for the default, ~/.config/monarch-money-mcp/session.json, which is where `monarch-money-mcp login` saves it.

tools.name: get_accounts
tools.description: Retrieve all linked financial accounts.

tools.name: get_account_type_options
tools.description: List valid account types and subtypes (needed for create_manual_account / update_account).

tools.name: get_institutions
tools.description: List connected financial institutions and their connection status.

tools.name: get_account_holdings
tools.description: Get investment holdings for a brokerage or similar account.

tools.name: get_account_history
tools.description: Get the full daily balance history for one account.

tools.name: get_recent_account_balances
tools.description: Get daily balances for all accounts from start_date (default: last 31 days).

tools.name: get_net_worth_history
tools.description: Get the daily net worth (sum of all accounts), optionally limited to one account type.

tools.name: get_account_snapshots_by_type
tools.description: Get net balances grouped by account type, by month or by year.

tools.name: create_manual_account
tools.description: Create a manual (non-synced) account.

tools.name: update_account
tools.description: Update an account's settings.

tools.name: delete_account
tools.description: Permanently delete an account and its transactions.

tools.name: upload_account_balance_history
tools.description: Upload daily balance history for a manual account.

tools.name: refresh_accounts
tools.description: Request a refresh of account data from financial institutions.

tools.name: get_refresh_status
tools.description: Check whether a previously requested account refresh has finished.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Fetch transactions with optional filtering.

tools.name: get_transaction_details
tools.description: Get full details for one transaction (original statement text, attachments, splits, goal, etc.).

tools.name: get_transactions_summary
tools.description: Get aggregate transaction stats (count, sums, averages, date range) for the whole household.

tools.name: create_transaction
tools.description: Create a new transaction.

tools.name: update_transaction
tools.description: Update an existing transaction.

tools.name: delete_transaction
tools.description: Permanently delete a transaction.

tools.name: bulk_update_transactions
tools.description: Apply the same change to many transactions at once.

tools.name: bulk_delete_transactions
tools.description: Permanently delete many transactions at once.

tools.name: move_transactions
tools.description: Move transactions from one account to another.

tools.name: get_transaction_splits
tools.description: Get the split lines for a transaction.

tools.name: update_transaction_splits
tools.description: Replace a transaction's splits.

tools.name: upload_transaction_attachment
tools.description: Attach a local file (receipt, invoice, etc.) to a transaction.

tools.name: get_transaction_tags
tools.description: List all transaction tags.

tools.name: create_transaction_tag
tools.description: Create a transaction tag.

tools.name: set_transaction_tags
tools.description: Set the tags on a transaction.

tools.name: update_transaction_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag or change its color.

tools.name: delete_transaction_tag
tools.description: Delete a tag.

tools.name: get_transaction_categories
tools.description: List all transaction categories.

tools.name: get_transaction_category_groups
tools.description: List category groups (needed for create_transaction_category).

tools.name: create_transaction_category
tools.description: Create a transaction category in a category group.

tools.name: update_transaction_category
tools.description: Change a category's name, icon, group, or budget settings.

tools.name: delete_transaction_categories
tools.description: Delete one or more categories.

tools.name: create_category_group
tools.description: Create a category group.

tools.name: update_category_group
tools.description: Change a category group's name, icon, color, or budget type.

tools.name: delete_category_group
tools.description: Delete a category group.

tools.name: get_budgets
tools.description: Retrieve budget information.

tools.name: set_budget_amounts
tools.description: Set monthly budget amounts for one or more categories or category groups.

tools.name: get_cashflow
tools.description: Cash flow broken down by category, category group, and merchant.

tools.name: get_cashflow_summary
tools.description: Total income, expenses, savings, and savings rate for a period.

tools.name: get_recurring_transactions
tools.description: List upcoming recurring transactions (bills, subscriptions, income) with merchant, amount, and account.

tools.name: get_recurring_streams
tools.description: List every recurring series (subscriptions, bills, income) with frequency and amount.

tools.name: get_recurring_remaining_due
tools.description: Total recurring amount still due in a period (default: the current month).

tools.name: mark_stream_not_recurring
tools.description: Stop treating a recurring series as recurring (see get_recurring_streams for IDs).

tools.name: list_transaction_rules
tools.description: List the household's transaction rules (conditions and actions) in priority order.

tools.name: create_transaction_rule
tools.description: Create a transaction rule.

tools.name: delete_transaction_rule
tools.description: Delete a transaction rule by id (use list_transaction_rules to find it).

tools.name: update_transaction_rule
tools.description: Replace a rule's conditions and actions (anything not given is cleared).

tools.name: set_transaction_rule_order
tools.description: Move a rule to a new priority position (0 = first).

tools.name: preview_transaction_rule
tools.description: Show which existing transactions a rule would change, without saving it.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.description: List savings goals with balances, progress, and per-account allocations.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a savings goal.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update a savings goal's settings.

tools.name: archive_goal
tools.description: Archive a savings goal (can be restored with unarchive_goal).

tools.name: unarchive_goal
tools.description: Restore an archived savings goal.

tools.name: delete_goal
tools.description: Permanently delete a savings goal and its contribution history.

tools.name: contribute_to_goal
tools.description: Record a contribution from an account to a savings goal.

tools.name: withdraw_from_goal
tools.description: Record a withdrawal from a savings goal back to an account.

tools.name: set_goal_budget_amount
tools.description: Set the monthly budgeted contribution for a savings goal.

tools.name: get_merchants
tools.description: List or search merchants with transaction counts and default categories.

tools.name: get_merchant
tools.description: Get one merchant's details, including rule count and recurring settings.

tools.name: update_merchant
tools.description: Rename a merchant, set its default category, or change its recurring settings.

tools.name: delete_merchant
tools.description: Merge a merchant into move_to_merchant_id: its transactions, rules, and recurring settings move there and the merchant is removed.

tools.name: get_business_entities
tools.description: List the household's businesses, with their linked accounts and transaction counts.

tools.name: get_business_entity
tools.description: Get one business.

tools.name: get_business_entity_financials
tools.description: Income, expenses, and net assets per business for a date range, with monthly breakdowns.

tools.name: get_business_entity_summaries
tools.description: Transaction totals per business for a date range (income, expenses, savings).

tools.name: create_business_entity
tools.description: Create a business, to track its accounts and transactions separately.

tools.name: update_business_entity
tools.description: Update a business's details.

tools.name: delete_business_entity
tools.description: Delete a business.

tools.name: set_account_business_entity
tools.description: Assign accounts to a business, or leave business_entity_id out to unassign them.

tools.name: get_schedule_c_line_items
tools.description: List the IRS Schedule C line items Monarch can map categories to.

tools.name: get_schedule_c_category_mappings
tools.description: List which categories map to which Schedule C lines.

tools.name: set_schedule_c_category_mapping
tools.description: Map a category to a Schedule C line for a tax year (replaces its existing mapping).

tools.name: delete_schedule_c_category_mapping
tools.description: Remove a category's Schedule C mapping for a tax year.

tools.name: get_household_members
tools.description: List household members (IDs for owner_user_id).

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Find accounts, categories, merchants, tags, and other items by name, like the web app's command palette.

tools.name: get_credit_history
tools.description: Get credit score history.

tools.name: get_subscription_details
tools.description: Get the Monarch Money subscription plan and status.
